output.reason: The brief ties the timing to the 14 April Finance change, and the size of the figures adds up: referrals rose from 7% to 54% at 34% FCR, non-referred calls held at 82%, and tenured agents fell as much as new starters. That also fits the agent comment about bills going to BRT. It ends with a clear trial plan and a reason to stop the performance plans, though it admits it hasn't tested the cause directly.
